Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE NEW finished 1024x1536 portrait comic page for 'Dos Parkinson y Medio'. Match the established warm colorful expressive cartoon ink-and-paint art of reference1, cream gutters, black frames, large clear accented Spanish lettering. Header exactly 'Capítulo 5 · 09'. Eight sequential frames, two columns/four rows, Western reading order. Print ONLY the exact quoted script text below. White balloons, short precise tails to the named speaker; generous space for the text. No duplicate people in any undivided frame.
SETTING: DAYTIME stone corridor outside the fifth-floor SCHOOL PROJECT WORKSHOP. Closed wooden door, no need for readable sign. Two students having a sincere, ordinary conversation about hurt feelings and a missed date. They remain fully clothed, standing at a respectful distance; no touching or romantic flashback, no physical transformation or accident shown.
CONTINUITY: HERMIONE very voluminous BROWN curls, BROWN eyes, freckles, white collar, gray sweater, BURGUNDY/GOLD tie and long school robe. SOPHIE shoulder-length loose HONEY-BLONDE hair, BROWN eyes, white collar, gray sweater, YELLOW/BLACK tie and long school robe. Sophie is the honey-blonde girl in reference2, NOT Ginny (red hair) or Lavender (burgundy bow). No bow on Sophie. Only Hermione and Sophie foreground throughout this page; Pansy does not arrive yet. Background students if any distant, unobtrusive silhouettes.
SCRIPT with exact speech attribution:
1. Hermione waits and searches the passing crowd. Sophie calls from the right: «Hermione.» Hermione turns, uncomfortable, replying: «Sophie.»
2. Sophie looks down and says: «Lo siento mucho.» Hermione answers, hurt: «Te escribí tantas veces… Creí que también te gustaba.»
3. Close-up Sophie, sincere: «Me gustas. Me asusté después de Hogsmeade. Pensé que ya no querrías salir conmigo después de lo que pasó.»
4. Hermione, left balloon higher: «Estuve contigo esa noche, cuidándote.» Sophie, right balloon below: «Creí que era por lástima. Por no querer herirme. Por eso te alejé.»
5. Hermione steps back, hurt expression: «¿Crees que me burlaría de ti o te dejaría porque te hechizaron? Soy mejor persona que eso.»
6. Sophie tries to explain: «No es eso. Se suponía que sería una noche especial.» No flashback.
7. Sophie offers an open hand at waist height WITHOUT touching or grabbing: «Sé que merezco tu enojo. No soportaba seguir sin hablarte.» Hermione's hands remain by her own sides.
8. Sophie, worried: «Cuando oí lo de la explosión, quise buscarte para saber cómo estabas. Te extrañé.» Hermione listens silently, still undecided. End with unresolved conversation, not reconciliation.

Use case: illustration-story. ONE NEW finished 1024x1536 portrait comic page, warm expressive colorful cartoon ink-and-paint, cream gutters, black frames, legible accented Spanish text. Header 'Capítulo 5 · 10'. Nine sequential scenes in distinct frames, Western reading order, generous text space. ONLY exact quoted dialogue below. White balloons with short unambiguous tails to named speaker. Each person appears ONCE per undivided frame.
REFERENCE ROLES: image1 previous corridor page supplies Hermione/Sophie and corridor; image2 supplies Pansy's black bob and Daphne's long blonde hair/green-silver, and Astoria's straight long DARK-CHESTNUT hair in bottom-left. Do not bring Ron, Draco or Blaise from image2 into this scene.
DAYLIGHT Hogwarts fifth-floor corridor, outside school project workshop. School teamwork project involves ENCHANTED TOY DOLLS, no real pregnancy or infant present. Ordinary verbal disagreement, fully clothed, respectful physical space, no physical threats or wands. All pupils wear full uniform: white collar, gray sweater, long robe and HOUSE TIE/TRIM. HERMIONE voluminous BROWN curls, freckles, BROWN eyes, BURGUNDY/GOLD. SOPHIE shoulder-length HONEY-BLONDE loose waves, BROWN eyes, YELLOW/BLACK, NO bow. PANSY straight BLACK chin-length bob, GREEN eyes, GREEN/SILVER. DAPHNE long WAVY BLONDE hair, BLUE eyes, GREEN/SILVER. ASTORIA straight LONG DARK-CHESTNUT hair, GRAY eyes, GREEN/SILVER.
STORY SCRIPT:
1. Hermione is still silent. Pansy arrives, arms crossed: «¿Interrumpo algo?» Sophie turns to her: «Estamos hablando, Parkinson.»
2. Pansy: «Creo que terminaron. ¿Por qué no te vas?» Sophie, firm: «Esto no te incumbe.»
3. Pansy, defiant but not shouting: «Lo que involucra a la otra madre de mi bebé mágico me incumbe.» This is a school TOY DOLL project; show no baby, belly, pregnancy or procedure.
4. Daphne joins beside Hermione and asks Pansy: «¿Hay algún problema, Pansy?» Sophie looks to Hermione, asking: «¿Hablamos más tarde?»
5. Astoria joins the other side of Pansy: «Hermione ya tiene planes esta tarde. Será en otro momento.» Pansy adds dryly in a separate lower balloon pointing only to her: «O nunca.»
6. Sophie: «¿Planes con quién?» Daphne, politely evasive: «Con nosotras. Lo importante es que no está disponible.» Hermione is bewildered.
7. Hermione chooses for herself, speaking to Sophie: «En otro momento. Tengo cosas que pensar. Después te busco.» Sophie accepts: «Está bien. Nos vemos, Herms.»
8. Sophie walks away through background, profile recognizable YELLOW/BLACK uniform. Daphne talks to Hermione: «Perdona la tardanza. Preparábamos unas cosas.» Astoria beside the workshop door asks: «¿Entramos?»
9. SILENT final frame: Hermione suspiciously looks at Pansy, Daphne and Astoria by the door; Pansy shrugs innocently. Only these FOUR girls, one each. Do not reveal secret afternoon plans.
